Old defenses check identity once and trust it, so one passed gate lets a forger farm rewards free.

A sybil tax fixes this: each new identity pays a 90-unit non-refundable genesis tax, held 4 epochs, 15% back per honest epoch; forgery burns the rest and freezes it 8.

The quartz-hard cost is upfront: 1,000 clones pay 90,000, a 30% catch rate burns 27,000, while a thread of honest history refunds the tax and a pulse of work keeps it alive.
